assertions.title: Registration toggle controls UI affordance + registration API

steps.observed: Sign-up link removed (screenshot shows no Sign up link)

steps.action: POST /api/auth/register without invite token while disabled
Create valid invite token then POST /api/auth/register with token while disabled
steps.observed: 200 and invited account could log in

evidence.network: GET /api/config -> 200 with registrationEnabled=false after toggle; POST /api/auth/register without invite -> 403; POST /api/auth/register with invite token -> 200

assertions.issues: /register remains fully accessible when registration is disabled; contract expects redirect or clear disabled-registration state.

assertions.title: New non-admin users receive documented default model allowlist

steps.action: Invite-signup a brand-new local non-admin user and login
steps.expected: First session gets default restricted model allowlist
steps.observed: /api/models returned openAI:[gpt-5.1], google:[gemini-2.5-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash-preview], ollama:[* subset/all discovered]

steps.action: Compare with superadmin account model catalog
steps.observed: Superadmin /api/models included full multi-provider model list

evidence.network: POST /api/auth/login invited user -> 200; GET /api/models invited -> 200 restricted list; GET /api/models superadmin -> 200 full list

assertions.issues: Federated/auto-provisioned auth path was not testable on this dev rail (all social/federated login toggles disabled in /api/config), so full contract coverage is blocked.

assertions.title: Superadmin model-permission overrides work; invalid overrides rejected; lower-tier forbidden

steps.expected: 200 and target user model visibility changes immediately
steps.observed: 200; val-user /api/models became openAI-only with google/ollama empty

steps.action: Superadmin PATCH restrictive modelPermissions on superadmin target

evidence.network: PATCH /api/admin/users/{val-user} valid -> 200; invalid endpoint -> 400; invalid model -> 400; workspace patch -> 403; PATCH superadmin target -> 200 with unrestricted superadmin /api/models still full

assertions.title: Model restrictions enforced server-side across config/chat/agents/assistants

steps.action: Restrict val-user to openAI:gpt-5.1 and fetch config/models
steps.observed: /api/models filtered to openAI only; /api/config returned restricted-user config

steps.action: Attempt blocked model usage through agent/assistant/chat probes
steps.expected: Explicit model-access denial errors across surfaces
steps.observed: First blocked agent probe returned event error "Illegal request" then temporary-ban responses (403) blocked further probe execution

evidence.network: GET /api/models restricted user -> 200 filtered; POST /api/agents (blocked model probe) -> 200 event error Illegal request; subsequent POST probes -> 403 temporary ban

assertions.issues: Anti-abuse/violation controls triggered during blocked-model probes, causing temporary bans that prevented completing the full agents/assistants/chat enforcement matrix with conclusive model-access error signatures.

assertions.title: Registration gating + invite signup + default restrictions + superadmin sync alignment

steps.action: Disable registration and run invite-based signup flow
steps.expected: Invite signup still works under disabled registration
steps.observed: Invite signup succeeded while direct signup failed with 403

steps.action: Login invited user immediately after signup
steps.expected: Default restricted model policy applies in first authenticated session
steps.observed: Invited user first-session /api/models was restricted as documented

steps.expected: Allowlisted user receives immediate superadmin permissions and unrestricted catalog in-session
steps.observed: val-superadmin had isSuperAdmin=true and full catalog, but SUPERADMIN_EMAILS env value was unavailable via container probe (printenv returned empty) so allowlist-origin check could not be confirmed

evidence.network: POST /api/auth/register direct -> 403; POST /api/auth/register invite -> 200; GET /api/admin/permissions superadmin -> 200 isSuperAdmin=true; GET /api/models superadmin -> 200 full list

assertions.issues: Could not conclusively verify allowlist-driven auto-promotion source because SUPERADMIN_EMAILS env value was not retrievable in this isolation run.

frictions.description: agent-browser network-idle waits timed out intermittently on dev rail; fixed waits were required for deterministic screenshots.
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser wait 5000 before capture; collected screenshots successfully.

frictions.description: Model-enforcement probe requests on agent/chat surfaces triggered violation handling (Illegal request -> temporary ban), interrupting deeper probe sequence.
frictions.resolution: Reduced probe volume, restored user model permissions, and marked remaining matrix coverage blocked.

frictions.description: Federated auth surfaces were disabled in /api/config, preventing required federated/auto-provisioned validation path execution.
frictions.resolution: Captured config evidence and marked VAL-MODEL-001 blocked for that missing path.

blockers.description: Federated/auto-provisioned auth path unavailable (social/federated login toggles all false in dev config).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Validated /api/config auth flags and attempted to rely on available seeded personas; still no federated flow available.

blockers.description: Anti-abuse temporary bans triggered during blocked-model enforcement probes on agent/chat surfaces.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Waited for login-rate reset window, retried with reduced probe volume and browser-like User-Agent, then restored permissions.

blockers.description: SUPERADMIN_EMAILS allowlist source could not be confirmed via environment probe (empty printenv output in dev-api container).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Checked superadmin runtime permissions/models directly; allowlist-origin confirmation remained unavailable.

summary: Assigned 5 assertions tested on dev rail: PASS=1 (VAL-MODEL-002), FAIL=1 (VAL-AUTH-001), BLOCKED=3 (VAL-MODEL-001, VAL-MODEL-003, VAL-CROSS-001). State mutations (registration toggle and model-permission overrides) were restored to baseline and temporary invited test user was deleted.
